title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Chozhan earns money to buy Nila a gold bangle. While Vannathi tries to avoid Pandian at the theatre, rogues follow Cheran and Chandayatha on their drive.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: Lakshmi proves her worth while Malar hires a new maid. Mathi tricks Lakshmi into taking charge, and tensions flare as Thangaraj explodes when Suresh says he apologised to Malar.

title: Bigg Boss
episodeTitle: BBTam Day 54: An Emotional Sentence to Jail
description: Food fights kick off the day, and the weekly task ends with Danya and Karishma sent to jail. Prithvi faces heat for giving water to the inmates.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Police arrest Abhinav and Neethimaan while Rajangam praises Tamizhselvi's group but shuns Eshwari and Chithra. Tamizhselvi vents after uncovering Aishwarya's voice trick.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Shyam orders Madhu to stay away from Arjun, who rejects her lunch. After Madhu shares a past memory, Shyam says he would visit her home to discuss their upcoming marriage.

title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Anbu takes Kanmani to a pregnancy workshop for support during her pregnancy. Meanwhile, Vennila manipulates Mathangi to hasten Kanmani and Anbu's divorce proceedings.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Kandhasamy stops Shanmugam's secret marriage with Abhi and confronts him over his decision. He then emphasises the family's hardships and the sacrifices made for his future.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Meena apologises to Gomathi for her harsh words and reconciles with her. Meanwhile, Sakthivel plans a grand birthday celebration for Gandhimathi by inviting Gomathi's family.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Sinthamani blocks Chandra from seeing Meena over Muthu's insult to Sathya. Shruthi and Ravi share their pregnancy news and cut ties with her parents for their hurtful actions.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: With Vetri's support, Sandhya brings the groom's crime to light and rejects the marriage proposal. Elsewhere, Divya recommends her boss as a suitable match for Swetha.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Azhagar refuses a drink, but Poongodi suspects otherwise. Devastated to learn he drinks, Meenatchi hits Azhagar, while Mayandi and Nandhini grow deeply upset with him.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Paraman publicly apologises after fighting Siddharth over Ilamathi. As Siddharth bribes voters with drinks for the election, the village women gather to meet Kalamma.
